summary: Tested staging env, super admin console (accounts list/search/filters/export/add, account switcher, Ctrl+K quick nav, workspace tabs: overview/staff/customers/branding/logo/features/domain/import/onboarding/status), global feature switches, white-label tenant preview + tenant registration, hospital-admin /my-hospital, landing page (desktop + 390px), PWA assets/SW, and XFF-spoof login lockout regression. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass. Frontend: all requested flows work; one functional gap (feature flags are cosmetic only - no route/API enforcement) and a few minor UI issues.

minor.issue: Feature flags are not enforced server-side. With pharmacy_marketplace OFF, only nav-pharmacy is hidden; no backend dependency checks effective_flags, so the APIs keep working (grep: effective_flags only used in /flags, /tenant, admin views).
'Default language chosen' is always done because create_account sets default_language='ar' by default - checklist step is meaningless (new account shows 2/8 done immediately).
Inviting an existing email silently overwrites that user's global role (e.g. existing patient becomes doctor) without the clinician approval flow. Admin-only, but worth a confirm/guard.
get_object() is a sync storage call inside an async route (blocks event loop).

ui_bugs.issue: With pharmacy_marketplace OFF, patient omar can still open /pharmacy directly by URL (no route guard).

When accountId changes (quick-nav person click or switcher from another account), the previous account's title and an empty PeopleTab (queried with the OLD account_id) are shown for ~1-1.5s before refreshing. State is not reset on accountId change and there is no stale-request guard (possible race if responses arrive out of order).
After registering on /auth?tenant=ACC-..., /onboarding shows hardcoded 'Sihha AI' brand instead of tenant brand (Onboarding.jsx line ~70 does not use BrandMark).

issues: Brand name truncated to 'Sihh...' next to Clinicians/Sign in buttons
'Hospitals' tab is cut off at the right edge (scrollable container, but no visual cue); audience tabs have no aria-selected
Content capped at ~1220px and left-aligned, leaving a large empty right area
Bar renders only after /api/env resolves (absent for ~1s on first load)

action_items: Enforce feature flags: add a backend dependency (e.g. require_feature('pharmacy_marketplace')) on gated routes and a frontend route guard that redirects when isOn(key) is false
AccountWorkspace: reset account/overview state when accountId changes and ignore stale responses
Use tenant BrandMark on Onboarding (and other post-login pages) during tenant preview
Fix 'Default language chosen' checklist logic (track explicit choice)
Mobile landing header: avoid brand name truncation; add scroll hint/wrap for audience tabs
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4165 lines - split super-admin/white-label section into its own router module
Feature flags only drive UI nav visibility; not a security/entitlement boundary as implemented
invite_account_user/update_account_user can change global role patient<->doctor, bypassing the clinician approval path
Account-level login lockout (10 fails, any IP) lets anyone lock out a known email for 15 min (accepted trade-off, documented)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass; flag route guard missing)
